records.question: What is the estimated total number of nesting female turtles per year in the whole Territory (species combined)?
ground_truth_chunks: Two turtle species are found in American Samoa, the green turtle ((Chelonia mydas) and the hawksbill (Eretmochelys imbricata).
We estimate that turtles in the whole Territory now total only about 120 nesting females (species combined) per year (Tuato'o-Bartley et al. 1993).

records.question: In what months do humpback whales migrate into American Samoa to breed and calve?
ground_truth_chunks: Small numbers of humpback whales (Megaptera novaeangliae) migrate into our waters to breed and calve, primarily from August through October.
